rules.name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
rules.query:
// Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task (T1053.005)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| where Process has_any ("Scheduled Task")
| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, TargetUserName
| where count_ > 10
